quote: We've been lying for a long time, Francis. Imagine what the voters would think if we started telling the truth. Not to them. To each other. How have we been lying to each other?
chinese: 我们已经撒谎很长时间了 弗兰西斯 想想如果对选民说真话会怎样 不是对选民 是对彼此 我们怎么对彼此撒谎了
reason: 从政治谎言转向婚姻内部诚实

quote: I found you once. I can find you again. If this information is wrong, you die. You try to contact her, you die.
chinese: 我找到过你一次 还能再找到你 如果信息有误你死定了 你试图联系她也死定了
reason: 用可追踪性与死亡条件封住后路

quote: Frank Underwood is a dangerous man. Power in the hands of those who lack honesty lacks a moral compass. Without a moral compass, power runs amok.
chinese: 弗兰克·安德伍德是个危险的人 权力掌握在不诚实的人手里便失去道德指引 没有指引权力便会胡作非为
reason: 用诚实、道德与权力因果链攻击对手

quote: You have the power to choose. Choose progress over pettiness. You have the power, not him. Choose a president over a charlatan.
chinese: 你们有选择的权力 选择进步而非小气 权力在你们不在他 选一个总统而非装相的
reason: 连续祈使句完成投票号召

quote: We're going to build the future together. I say together because I can't do it alone. I need your help.
chinese: 我们将共同创造未来 我说共同 因为我一个人做不来 我需要你们帮忙
reason: 从共同未来落到直接请求支持

quote: Cassie Lockhart. Social Security card, driver's license, birth certificate. It's all legit.
chinese: 凯茜·洛克哈特 社保卡 驾照 出生证明 全都没问题
reason: 用文件清单确认新身份完整

quote: It's not much to look at, but it runs well. How much? Twelve hundred. I don't got a title, so technically you're buying it for parts.
chinese: 是不咋地 但跑起来没问题 多少钱 一千二 车没手续 所以算买零部件
reason: 核对旧车状况、价格与手续

quote: Bianca got her protected status. That's so great! She says thank you for all your help with her paperwork. Of course. We're celebrating.
chinese: 比安卡拿到保护身份了 太棒了 她感谢你帮她做手续 不客气 我们要庆祝
reason: 好消息、感谢与庆祝的日常交流

quote: Once I save up enough, I want my own car and my own place. Up north, in the woods. I miss the trees and the rain. Someplace quiet. Something new.
chinese: 等我攒够钱 想买车和自己的房子 在北边林子里 我想念树和雨 找个安静的新地方
reason: 以储蓄目标描绘新生活

quote: If we win, it'll be strange if she isn't standing next to you. Even stranger if you make a concession speech. Then her absence will be the least of our problems.
chinese: 如果赢了而她没陪您会很奇怪 如果是落选演讲更怪 那第一夫人不在就不是最该担心的
reason: 从舞台形象推演到失败优先级

quote: I'm going for a run. Can you arrange the detail? It might highlight that you're not in Iowa. If it's a problem, tell me.
chinese: 我要去跑步 能安排安保吗 这可能提醒人们您不在爱荷华 如果有问题就说
reason: 日常请求被政治观感限制

quote: Every major poll has it as a dead heat, both candidates at 45 percent. One in ten likely caucus-goers won't decide until tomorrow evening.
chinese: 所有大型民调都表示难分上下 两名候选人都在45% 还有10%的人直到明晚才决定
reason: 数字交代选前僵局和未决选民

quote: No matter what happens tomorrow night, I want you by my side. You don't have to do events or press, just be there when I make my speech.
chinese: 不管明晚结果如何 我希望你陪在身边 不用参加活动或见媒体 只要我演讲时陪着我
reason: 把公开陪伴请求降到最低参与要求

quote: I'm sorry for what I did. I wish I could take it back. I thought I killed you. You didn't deserve it. None of this is going to change anything.
chinese: 很抱歉我那么对你 真希望能收回 我以为我杀了你 你不该遭受那样的事 这都不会改变什么
reason: 道歉和悔意仍被受害者判定无效

quote: I was wondering if we could talk honestly to each other, if you'd be open to that. About what? New Hampshire.
chinese: 我想问我们能否开诚布公地谈谈 不知道你是否愿意 谈什么 新罕布什尔
reason: 先征求同意再明确谈话主题

quote: I'm asking for me. I need to know. Hatred. For how much you and Frank needed each other. I used that word? Hate? You did.
chinese: 我是为自己问 我想知道 厌恶 你厌恶你和弗兰克多么需要彼此 我说厌恶了吗 是啊
reason: 得到对互相依赖的尖锐判断

quote: I ask a question, and neither of you answer. It's tiresome, swinging a sledgehammer at the façade just to glimpse through the cracks.
chinese: 我问问题你们都不回答 一遍遍用大锤敲打伪装的墙 只为了从裂缝一窥真相 很累人
reason: 用敲墙隐喻长期回避

quote: Tell me what you see. Somebody who's lost. I'd rather imagine who you might be than who you actually are.
chinese: 告诉我你看到了什么 一个迷茫的人 我宁可想象你可能的样子 而不是看到真实的你
reason: 关于迷失与想象的残酷回答

quote: Can you live with yourself? What's the point? I can't hurt you. No one's ever gonna find me or know who I am.
chinese: 你能原谅自己吗 这有什么意义 我伤不了你 没人能找到我或知道我是谁
reason: 以道德后果与无威胁论证求生

quote: Still a toss-up. Less than half a point gap. The margin of error is 4.5. The lead's gone back and forth. Bottom line is turnout.
chinese: 还是难说 差距不到半个百分点 误差4.5% 领跑人反复变化 归根结底看出席率
reason: 正确解释小差距与误差范围

quote: Mrs. Underwood postponed her flight. Agent Swift said Tom Yates came to the residence last night. Tell Vaughn I'll be down in a few minutes.
chinese: 安德伍德夫人推迟航班 斯威夫特特工说汤姆昨晚去了总统府邸 告诉沃恩我马上过去
reason: 私人坏消息后仍切回公开行程

quote: It's me. When you get this message, will you please call me?
chinese: 是我 你收到留言后能给我回电话吗
reason: 连续无人接听后的克制请求

quote: Rachel's gone. That is who I am now. You could've killed me last night, but you kept me alive. I know this isn't who you are.
chinese: 瑞秋已经没了 这才是我现在的身份 你昨晚可以杀我但留了我一命 我知道你不是这种人
reason: 以旧身份已死和对方迟疑争取生路

quote: You don't have to kill Rachel. She's already dead. If you do this, you're not killing Rachel, you're killing Cassie.
chinese: 你不用杀瑞秋 她已经死了 你要动手杀的不是瑞秋 而是凯茜
reason: 以新旧身份区分进行求生重构

quote: Cassie wants someplace far away where nobody'll find her. She wants a dog, a queen-size bed, blankets to curl up in. She doesn't want much. She just wants to be invisible.
chinese: 凯茜只想找个很远且没人找得到的地方 想养狗 要大床和毛毯 她要的不多 只想消失
reason: 用具体微小愿望让新身份成为可感生活

quote: My name is Cassie Lockhart.
chinese: 我叫凯茜·洛克哈特
reason: 以新名字完成身份声明

quote: I'd like to congratulate President Underwood. It was a tight race and he came out on top. We haven't lost. We are just getting started!
chinese: 我祝贺安德伍德总统 竞争激烈他最终胜出 我们没有输 我们才刚上路
reason: 承认结果后把失败重构为起点

quote: That's three hours from now. The crowd will wait. We don't want to squander primetime. At one in the morning, we lose major viewership.
chinese: 哪怕马上动身也要三小时 人们可以等 不能浪费黄金时段 凌晨一点会失去大量观众
reason: 在等待与传播窗口间取舍

quote: I know you're wondering where Claire is. She's under the weather. But she's on the mend, and tomorrow we fly to New Hampshire, where we'll win there too.
chinese: 你们想知道克莱尔在哪 她稍有抱恙但正在恢复 明天我们飞新罕布什尔并拿下那里
reason: 用健康借口遮蔽缺席并承诺下一站亮相

quote: I had to give a victory speech alone. One way or another, I need you on that plane with me tomorrow.
chinese: 我刚一个人发表获胜演说 不管怎样 明天你一定要跟我上飞机
reason: 把公开受损转成硬要求

quote: When I said we were lying, I meant: I thought we were on this path together. But it's not what I thought it would be.
chinese: 我之前说撒谎 是说我以为我们一起走这条路 但却跟我想的不一样
reason: 解释谎言是对共同道路的自我欺骗

quote: We're two equal parts. We are. You really believe that? We earned this together. It's your office, not mine. You make the decisions.
chinese: 我们是平等的 你真相信吗 我们一起奋斗到今天 这是你的办公室不是我的 决定权都在你
reason: 咨询权不等于决定权的区分

quote: I had to ask for your help. I couldn't get confirmation on my own. What's wrong with asking for help? The fact that I need it. I hate that feeling.
chinese: 我还得向你求助 凭自己拿不下提名 找你帮忙怎么了 是我需要帮助 我厌恶那种感觉
reason: 把具体失败转化为对依赖本身的厌恶

quote: I don't recognize myself in the mirror. I can't even talk with you. Instead you want me to slap you around like some animal.
chinese: 我照镜子都不认识自己 都没法跟你好好谈 你却想让我像畜生一样对你
reason: 身份疏离与沟通失败集中爆发

quote: You can't have it both ways. You want an equal partner when it suits you, and a man to take charge when it suits you? I'm supposed to divine which?
chinese: 你不能两者兼得 高兴了想要平等关系 想被掌控时又要男人掌控 难道要我猜吗
reason: 质问平等与掌控之间的矛盾期待

quote: We used to make each other stronger. That was a lie. We were making you stronger. Now I'm weak and small, and I can't stand that feeling any longer.
chinese: 我们以前互相支持 那也是假的 我们只是在支持你 我现在软弱又渺小 再也受不了
reason: 推翻共同增强为单向赋能

quote: The White House is not enough. Being First Lady is not enough. No. It's you that's not enough.
chinese: 进驻白宫不满足 做第一夫人也不满足 不 是你不满足
reason: 把制度不满转为对伴侣的否定

quote: You can hate me and be disgusted, because I'm beyond caring. But without me, you are nothing.
chinese: 你可以恨我觉得恶心 因为我不在乎 但没有我你什么都不是
reason: 以不在乎情感宣告绝对依赖

quote: You're right. This office has one chair. You have always known that from the beginning.
chinese: 你说得对 这办公室只有一把椅子 你从一开始就知道
reason: 用一把椅子承认权力结构不平等

quote: I have to run this country and win a nomination. I'm doing my job. Doug is doing his. It's time for you to do yours.
chinese: 我得治理国家赢得提名 我在做工作 道格也在做 你也该做你的工作
reason: 把婚姻角色降格为政治分工

quote: You want me to take charge? Fine. You will get on that plane, come to New Hampshire, smile, shake hands, kiss babies, and be the First Lady!
chinese: 你要我掌控吗 可以 明天上飞机 去新罕布什尔 微笑握手亲小孩 做第一夫人
reason: 连续命令把伴侣置于竞选角色下

quote: I don't give a damn if you vomit on your own time.
chinese: 私下里你可以随便恶心
reason: 把私人痛苦排除在公开职责外

quote: So? Are you okay? I'm good to go, sir.
chinese: 怎么样 你还好吗 我准备好了 先生
reason: Doug 完成任务后以可工作状态返回

quote: I'm not going to New Hampshire. Yes, you are. I'll see you in the car.
chinese: 我不去新罕布什尔 你要去 车里见
reason: 拒绝与命令直接相撞

quote: Francis. I'm not going to New Hampshire. Yes, you are. I'll see you in the car. I'm leaving you. Claire.
chinese: 弗兰西斯 我不去新罕布什尔 你要去 车里见 我要离开你 克莱尔
reason: 季终从行程拒绝推进到离开宣告
